attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: cms_article_publication
steps:
  - id: fetch_csrf_token
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/session/token"
      method: GET
    output: raw_csrf_token

  - id: extract_csrf_token
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: raw_csrf_token
      field: "csrf_token"
    output: csrf_token

  - id: authenticate_publisher
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "publisher"
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_article_payload
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: article_payload
      schema: cms_article_schema
    output: validated_article

  - id: extract_content_sections
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_article
      field: "content_sections"
    output: content_sections

  - id: create_paragraph_blocks
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: content_sections
      step: create_single_paragraph_block
    output: paragraph_block_responses

  - id: create_single_paragraph_block
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: content_sections
      url: "/jsonapi/node/article/paragraph"
      method: POST
      headers:
        Content-Type: "application/vnd.api+json"
        X-CSRF-Token: csrf_token
    output: raw_paragraph_response

  - id: validate_paragraph_responses
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: paragraph_block_responses
      schema: paragraph_block_response_schema
    output: validated_paragraph_responses

  - id: extract_block_uuids
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_paragraph_responses
      mapping:
        block_uuids: "$.data[*].attributes.uuid"
    output: block_uuids

  - id: build_article_node_payload
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_article
      mapping:
        title: "$.title"
        metadata: "$.metadata"
        paragraph_references: block_uuids
    output: article_node_payload

  - id: create_article_node
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: article_node_payload
      url: "/jsonapi/node/article"
      method: POST
      headers:
        Content-Type: "application/vnd.api+json"
        X-CSRF-Token: csrf_token
    output: raw_article_node_response

  - id: validate_article_node_response
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_article_node_response
      schema: cms_article_node_response_schema
    output: validated_article_node

  - id: extract_node_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_article_node
      field: "data.id"
    output: article_node_id

  - id: build_audit_entry
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_article_node
      mapping:
        article_title: "$.data.attributes.title"
        node_id: "$.data.id"
        timestamp: "$.meta.created"
    output: audit_entry

  - id: log_publication_audit
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: audit_entry
      event: "article_published"
      details:
        description: "Article successfully published to CMS"

  - id: handle_publication_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      step: create_article_node
      action: route_to_step
      target: notify_failure

  - id: notify_failure
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: audit_entry
      recipient: "publishing_team"
      message: "Article publication failed. Please review and retry."
